radiation.name: SOLAR PARTICLE EVENT (SPE)
radiation.description: SWPC satellites detect coronal mass ejection directed at Earth-Moon system. Extreme proton flux incoming.

depressurization.name: RAPID CABIN DEPRESSURIZATION
depressurization.description: Micrometeorite impact breach detected in external pressure hull. Atmosphere venting to vacuum.
